channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jaylen Brown | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jaylen Brown from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Carmelo Anthony on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Carmelo Anthony:

“Jaylen Brown is the best two-way player in the NBA…I think if Wemby wasn't in the league, [JB] could win defensive player of the year.”

Carmelo Anthony on Jaylen Brown, Oct 15, 2026. Source: Youtube.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
VJ Edgecombe:

“JB is one of my favorite people in the world. He’s a great person, someone that I talk to every day. He’s a leader, he’s just Jaylen Brown. He’s a great person and that’s someone that I just have a really good relationship with, even though we just met a few months ago.”

VJ Edgecombe on Jaylen Brown, Oct 14, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Neemias Queta on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Now that Brown has moved to Philadelphia this summer, their friendship will have to coexist with their rivalry.

“I've dunked on everybody on the court. Jaylen Brown is the only one left,”

Neemias Queta on Jaylen Brown, Oct 10, 2026. Source: A Bola.

item.title: Dean Wade on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Dean Wade on the high basketball IQ of new 76ers teammates:

“It is completely different. You know their tendencies playing against them, but when you are on the same team, you can pick their brain. My biggest thing is the way they think the game is the most impressive thing. Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, LeBron James, Jaylen Brown, everyone, the way they think the game is at such a high level. As an NBA player, you think you know the game well, and then you get on a team like this and it is night and day. You see the way they think about plays, think about defenses, the way they think about rotations. It is similar to some things I thought, but they go a little more in-depth and it is super impressive.”

Dean Wade on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Oct 1, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Charles Oakley on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
“He played the game. I mean, he played the right way. All year, he put the team in the place last year to make the playoffs without your main tailor, so Brown, he carried the whole team. I can’t believe they jumped to the conclusion to trade him. This other guy just tore his Achilles. And you gonna take a chance?”

Charles Oakley on Jaylen Brown, Sep 29, 2026. Source: Basketball Network.

item.title: Joel Embiid on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Derek Bodner:Joel Embiid, on Jaylen Brown:

“What he brings, on the defensive end, on the offensive end, it's hard to find that in the league. To be able to add that, then combine that with everything else he does on and off the court, I think it's going to be good for the city of Philadelphia.”

Joel Embiid on Jaylen Brown, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Paul George on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Celtics on CLNS: Paul George on Celtics Fans initial reaction to being involved in Jaylen Brown trade:

“No personal feelings towards the initial you know how it received here in Boston. To be honest it's fair…Hopefully with how we start this year they understand this is a new. You know a new team and something that they can be proud of.”

Paul George on Jaylen Brown, Sep 15, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
He asked how Stevens, who is the Celtics’ president of basketball operations, can trust his instincts when making unpopular decisions.

“Well, obviously, I’m sure a lot of people immediately got to Jaylen Brown, right, or immediately go to [Marcus Smart] a couple years ago, and that’s a really hard part of the job,”

Brad Stevens on Marcus Smart, Jaylen Brown, Aug 29, 2026. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Bob Myers on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Bob Myers:

“We needed an edge, and I think Jaylen Brown sets an edge. You need to win a championship, guys that are of that ilk, I think, that are comfortable being uncomfortable, if that makes sense. And he is one of those. And so the deal came down, and I didn't know Jaylen at all. I talked to him the day after, and I just said, listen, don't ever underestimate that you're a champion, and that there's power in that. So use that with this team. We don't have that on our team. And I said, we need you to lead. I'm going to ask you to lead.”

Bob Myers on Jaylen Brown, Aug 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nikola Vucevic on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Nikola Vucevic:

“I think there were some signs, mostly because the big contracts and the NBA’s new rules made it difficult for them to build the team. “With (Jayson) Tatum and Brown both on such big contracts, it wasn’t easy for them to fit the rest of the team around those two. But while I was there, did I sense anything between the players or any kind of problems? No, I honestly didn’t. I was as surprised as everyone else when the trade happened, even though there had been plenty written about it in the media. But plenty of things get reported and don’t end up happening.”

Nikola Vucevic on Jaylen Brown, Aug 23, 2026. Source: SKWEEK.

item.title: Payton Pritchard on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Payton Pritchard on Jaylen Brown:

“You just used to seeing big things and think changes happen all the time. It always sucks to see a brother and a teammate that you played with for a long time go, but you move on and you are ready to go to war.”

Payton Pritchard on Jaylen Brown, Aug 23, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Magic Johnson on Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
Johnson emphasized that LeBron’s influence extends far beyond mere distribution on the stat sheet, highlighting his innate ability to unify elite talent.

“When you think about Maxey, Embiid… all those guys, now Jaylen Brown,”

Magic Johnson on Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 21, 2026. Source: ScoopB.com.

item.title: Bill Chisholm on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Chisholm on the Jaylen Brown blockbuster:

“I definitely have a level of trust in Brad and his team... But as a fan, that was tough”

Bill Chisholm on Jaylen Brown, Aug 19, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Brad Stevens on trading Jaylen Brown:

“It’s something that you have to just say, do you think where we currently are…will get us to where we ultimately want to go?”

Brad Stevens on Jaylen Brown, Aug 16, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Tyrese Maxey on LeBron James, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Tyrese Maxey on having to sacrifice with LeBron and Jaylen Brown:

“At the end of the day I want to win, you know what I mean? And I have played with a lot of different people and a lot of different groups. So at the end of the day I am going to have to change some of the things but because of the dynamic of our team and like we don’t expect the process to play 70 games. But to play 70 games that’s how you balances out.”

Tyrese Maxey on LeBron James, Jaylen Brown, Aug 11, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Mike Gansey on LeBron James, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
“So I think sacrifice will be big for us. But Joel is arguably the best and most talented big I've ever been around. ... He's going to be a huge piece to our success. We have LeBron and Jaylen, but Joel's going to be as important as those guys.”

Mike Gansey on LeBron James, Jaylen Brown, Aug 6, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Grant Williams on Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Former Celtic Grant Williams on the relationship between Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown:

“You can bring the best out of someone else beside you. And I think that’s what it was for those two, that they had respect for one another, they enjoyed being around one another when they’re on the court, as well as they didn’t have any disdain for one another off the floor. So that’s something I can just vividly say is that I don’t think those guys disliked each other at all.”

Grant Williams on Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Aug 5, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Kevin Durant on Klay Thompson, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
“Joel, mvp recently. Jaylen brown, recent finals mvp, Tyrese Maxey, all star the last 3 years. We all know what bron does. Klay Thompson, never a mvp candidate in nothing, 22ppg. Draymond, 14ppg 7 rebounds 6 assist, Steph a mvp just like Joel was. I don’t get how the warriors team is better on paper.”

Kevin Durant on Klay Thompson, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 4, 2026. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Ron Harper Jr on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Ron Harper Jr. on the Celtics trading Jaylen Brown:

“Obviously, sad to see him go. A guy that I've grown close to in my time at the Celtics…A guy that still trusted me when I was still on an Exhibit 10. “So, I remember the message he shared with me, the motivation he's given me, and the advice he's given me. And it sucks to see him go. But you know, this is a business more than anything. So I wish him luck in the future, except when he plays us.”

Ron Harper Jr on Jaylen Brown, Aug 4, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
“Just being a rookie and being able to be around all those guys is a privilege for me. You don’t get to see a rookie get to play with five guys that can potentially make an All-Star team [James, Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Joel Embiid, and VJ Edgecombe]. I feel like you can learn every day, and every day you can compete against them to get better.”

Labaron Philon on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Aug 3, 2026. Source: The Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: VJ Edgecombe on Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey
item.description:
As such, VJ Edgecombe can't wait longer to share the court with his childhood idol and play with a much more formidable Sixers squad.

“Just to learn, man. To me, he is the greatest of all time, so now we got him, [Jaylen Brown], Joe [Embiid], [Tyrese Maxey], it's a squad,”

VJ Edgecombe on Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, Aug 3, 2026. Source: BasketNews.

item.title: Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Channing Frye:

“Nick Nurse, one thing that's not taking into consideration is Nick Nurse is a beast. And so when you add all these personalities to a team, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, you know, Bron, VJ Edgecombe, you know, Jaylen Brown, you need a coach that can handle all that that's going to put them in the right situation. A lot of them, everyone's going to talk about usage rate, but Nick Nurse made it work in Toronto with, you know, OG Anunoby, Pascal Siakam, Kyle Lowry and Kawhi Leonard.”

Channing Frye on Kyle Lowry, Kawhi Leonard, Nick Nurse, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Pascal Siakam, OG Anunoby, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on LeBron James, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“It's championship or bust for LeBron and Jaylen. I don't want to hear about, 'Oh, 60 games, we made the playoffs.'”

Shaquille O'Neal on LeBron James, Jaylen Brown, Jul 28, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Josh Harris on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe
item.description:
Managing Partner Josh Harris said.

“I cannot wait to see LeBron alongside Jaylen Brown, VJ Edgecombe, Joel Embiid, Tyrese Maxey, and our talented roster as we work to deliver a championship for Philly. To LeBron and his family: we are grateful you chose the 76ers, and look forward to this next chapter of your legendary career. Welcome to the 76ers!”

Josh Harris on LeBron James, Joel Embiid, Jaylen Brown, Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jul 27, 2026. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Danny Green on Jaylen Brown, LeBron James
item.description:
Danny Green on LeBron James' decision:

“I was like this can’t be real news, Shams is somebody hacking you, this can’t be real news, you know what I’m saying? 2 years $8 million to Philly none of that was in the cards for me. So, yeah it was shocking it was just as shocking as the Jaylen Brown news probably for me.”

Danny Green on Jaylen Brown, LeBron James, Jul 24, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
“I think the thing that’s different is obviously having a respect and an understanding of what Jaylen has done for the Celtics for 10 years. So, there’s a difference between maybe a young guy going through something and a guy like Jaylen, who has accomplished so much and done what he’s done for the organization going through it. And so, you definitely have a higher sense of empathy for that.”

Joe Mazzulla on Jaylen Brown, Jul 12, 2026. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Hugo Gonzalez on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
On Thursday, he shared his gratitude for the overlapping year he shared with Brown.

“Jaylen is a Celtics legend, and everybody, [starting with me], is really, really grateful because of the things he has done,”

Hugo Gonzalez on Jaylen Brown, Jul 11, 2026. Source: Yahoo! Sports.

item.title: Neemias Queta on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
“I think you feel for him. Obviously, it wasn’t easy for him as well. But at the end of the day, it’s part of the business. You know what’s happening. You know it can happen at any moment. But Jaylen’s a guy that you can’t replace in the city. Really, really hard to replace on the court as well. He did so much for Boston in general, and he will definitely be missed.”

Neemias Queta on Jaylen Brown, Jul 11, 2026. Source: Celtics Blog.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Jaylen Brown
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Jaylen Brown:

“It’s not a black and white thing. There's a feeling that goes into it. There's an emotion that goes into it. There's a processing pattern that goes into it. “The quicker you can get to — it's just a level of gratitude. He made me a better coach. I know that for a fact. The way he pushed me, the way he pushed himself, the way he pushed the locker room. He made me a better coach, and that's what you focus on.”

Joe Mazzulla on Jaylen Brown, Jul 9, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Jeff Teague on Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Jeff Teague on Shams Charania report on Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown personal relationship:

“Don’t nobody be cool with people like that on a team, bro. I’m going to tell y’all the truth don’t nobody hang with nobody for real, for real, like you might have a couple people that hang but people be work homeboys. I think about all the teammates I was cool with when I was on the team we done had some of them, “You want to do the pod?”

Jeff Teague on Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Jul 8, 2026. Source: x.com.
